correctness.rationale: For G≅(Z/2)^4 and five inertia classes with one relation, the five nontrivial characters positive on exactly one class define genus-one double quotients E_i. On Jacobians the degree-eight push–pull and character involutions imply π_{i*}π_i^*=[8] and π_{i*}π_j^*=0 for i≠j: the latter is both its own negative and a homomorphism in torsion-free Hom of abelian varieties. Thus ΦΨ=[8] and Ψ is a 5-prime-to isogeny of dimension-five abelian varieties, so f(C)=5−#{supersingular E_i}. For E:y²=x(x−1)(x−t), [x^4]([x(x−1)(x−t)]²)=t²+4t+1=t²−t+1 mod5. If two distinct supersingular four-subsets exist, normalize their common three branch points to ∞,0,1 and their two remaining points u,v must be the distinct roots u²−u+1=v²−v+1=0; hence u+v=uv=1. Independent Gröbner reduction modulo (u+v−1,uv−1) gave −2 mod5 for each of the three remaining supersingularity numerators Q1,Q0,Q∞. Thus no three are supersingular, and a two-supersingular set is uniquely PGL2-equivalent to the roots. Explicit smooth configurations (roots u,v), (root,2), (2,3) give 5-ranks 3,4,5. Independent SymPy polynomial reduction and a separately implemented exact F25 sweep of 506 ordered valid parameter pairs gave 306/180/20 cases with 0/1/2 supersingular quotients, agreeing with all three witnesses. The proof for every algebraically closed char5 field is symbolic and not inferred from F25 testing.

value.rationale: The two-dimensional tame Humbert locus is a classical and natural genus-five family with five already-known elliptic Jacobian factors. The previously uncomputed sharp geometric 5-rank distribution {3,4,5}, strict impossibility of 5-ranks 0,1,2, and a unique extremal rank-three branch class constitute an intrinsic arithmetic stratification, not a textbook consequence of decomposition or a random tiny finite slice. The exact extremal point and its supersingular-pair obstruction may be used in future arithmetic, moduli, and Newton-stratum comparisons. Value does not depend on a general theorem for unrelated curves.
